text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening, while walking through the 
quiet, deserted school building—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The graceful timbre of a violin. As if 
drawn in by it, my feet carried me toward 
the sound.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I'll gladly accept your praise.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I will be performing in a concert soon. So 
I decided to practice for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Such a clear tone, as always.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I heard music and ended up wandering over. 
Mind if I listen in while I take a break?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...If that is what you wish to do, I do 
not mind.
choice_data_list: Then I think I'll listen in too.

Then maybe I'll stick around and listen 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby continued her practice. She 
would play the violin, record it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Comparing recordings and making 
improvements. Though her expression 
remains unchanged, alternating between the 
violin and her smartphone seems like quite 
a handful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No. As this is not training, you are under 
no such obligation.
choice_data_list: It's because I want to do it.
I want to be the one to do it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think that's a good idea too. That 
way, you can focus more on playing, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ............ Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The violin's melody resonates. Its sound 
is orderly and appears well-balanced, but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, a bit stiff, perhaps... I'm 
concerned about how well it fits the 
music."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Recording it, adjusting it bit by bit—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's settling in nicely. Doesn't feel 
out of place at all anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Eventually—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nice, it's getting smooth! It fits the 
melody really well too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps satisfied with the results of her 
practice, Daiichi Ruby herself lowered her 
violin.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Please excuse my clumsy performance. 
Thank you very much for your assistance."
choice_data_list:
It almost feels like a waste for just the 
two of us to listen to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Daiichi Ruby that not only did I 
enjoy hearing the music, but it had made 
for great practice as well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, getting to hear Ruby play is a rare 
opportunity, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it was fun watching the process 
of things changing.
choice_data_list:
I'm sure the concert will be a huge 
success

I'm sure the concert will be a huge 
success

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I intend to do everything in my power 
to make that happen.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well now, lured here by a pleasant breeze, 
what do I find?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So it was Ruby playing. Did... the 
atmosphere change a bit?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...So you two felt it as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Compared to the usual calm 
atmosphere, there was a wonderfully breezy 
charm to it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So much so that I wanted to keep listening 
just a little longer...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'd like to listen a bit longer too. 
What do you think, Ruby?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“...... In that case, I shall continue 
practicing for a little while longer.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the classroom bathed in the rays of 
the setting sun, Daiichi Ruby's 
performance echoed for a while.
